artifacts.description: A list. Always empty: this tool does not generate files.

content.description: An object. Discovery call sheet content. facts are literal attributed quotes only. All four prerequisites must be explicit. Missing evidence means Unknown, never Established. With no interview or earlier answers, facts are empty and all prerequisites Unknown.

blocks.description: A list. Timed blocks, in sheet order. The first is Where they want to go (Q1-Q3) and the last is Wrap up (Q193-Q195). Empty only in the wrong-tool case.

note.description: Text. Empty, or a short instruction such as: Follow their answers. Email what's left.

time.description: Text. Minutes from the start as h:mm-h:mm. Blocks run back to back from 0:03 and stop 4 minutes before the end.

send_after.description: A list. Documents, counts or examples to ask for after the call.

wrap.description: A list. 2-3 steps to end the call: play back themes, confirm the first priority, agree the next date.

duration_minutes.description: A whole number. Call length in minutes from the request, otherwise 60.

facts.description: A list. Literal attributed quotes from earlier answers the user supplied for tailoring (for example a mini assessment). Empty when nothing was supplied. Never findings or inferences.

quote.description: Text. Exact contiguous source text only, no paraphrase or inference.

hypotheses.description: A list. Ideas the user supplied before the call, to confirm or drop. Empty unless the request states them.

id.description: Text. H1, H2 and so on.

leave_with.description: Text. What the interviewer must leave the call knowing, in one sentence built from the objective. At most 160 characters.

listen_for.description: A list. 0-5 unscored ideas tied to the supplied business or bottleneck. Never findings, scores or pitches.

idea.description: Text. An unscored idea to test against the answers. At most 160 characters.

numbers.description: A list. Bank numbers of the questions on this sheet that test it.

items.description: Text. Q plus digits, such as Q16.

objective.description: Text. The supplied outcome or bottleneck in plain words, or Unknown. Never a generic placeholder. For a mini report or full-assessment request, the wrong-tool sentence from the skill instructions; then agenda, questions and custom_followups are empty.

opening.description: A list. 3-5 bullets for the first three minutes: permission to record, framing around the objective, one question at a time.

evidence.description: Text. Verbatim source span establishing this prerequisite, or empty string if absent. Unknown for silence. An unmeasured estimate is Not established for baseline.
Text. Verbatim source span establishing this prerequisite, or empty string if absent. Unknown for silence. An unmeasured estimate is Not established for baseline.
Text. Verbatim source span establishing this prerequisite, or empty string if absent. Unknown for silence. An unmeasured estimate is Not established for baseline.
Text. Verbatim source span establishing this prerequisite, or empty string if absent. Unknown for silence. An unmeasured estimate is Not established for baseline.

questions.description: A list. Every question in sheet order, each naming its block. Q1-Q3 first, Q193-Q195 last.

block.description: A whole number. 1-based position of this question's block in blocks.

capture.description: Text. Write down: what to note for the assessment. At most 110 characters.

email_ok.description: True or false. True when a written answer after the call would do.

known.description: Text. We know: what the facts already say about this question, or empty. At most 160 characters.

lens.description: A list. Bank question: its tags exactly. Custom: what it probes. E revenue, F hours, Q client experience.

must_ask.description: True or false. True for the six core questions and the few that serve the objective most.

number.description: Text. Original bank number as Q12, or Custom for a question that is not in the bank.

order.description: A whole number. Position on the sheet, 1 to N in the order the questions appear.

probes.description: A list. Dig deeper: 2-4 short follow-ups that pull out numbers, owners and examples.

text.description: Text. Bank question: the exact canonical text. Custom: one open question tied to the supplied business.

why.description: Text. Why ask: what the answer decides for the assessment. At most 110 characters.

HTML/PDF: A4 portrait pages, full-bleed #000000 canvas with printed backgrounds; margins 14mm top and sides, 18mm bottom; verified logo top right, 12mm high; one reading column. Page 1: eyebrow AI OPPORTUNITY ASSESSMENT · DISCOVERY CALL SHEET in Montserrat 800 #F06000, the business or Discovery call as the title with the 72x3px #F06000 rule, a mono meta line (call length, question count, must-ask count), the objective in a #1A1A1A panel, and leave_with as the one #F06000 callout labelled LEAVE WITH, #000000 text. Then two #1A1A1A panels side by side (stacked when narrow): OPEN WITH (opening bullets, first three minutes) and IDEAS TO TEST (hypotheses, omitted when empty). Then ALREADY KNOWN: CONFIRM, DON'T RE-ASK, the facts as quotes with speakers, omitted when empty. Each block is a band: mono time in #F06000, the title in Montserrat 800 uppercase #FFFFFF, the note right-aligned in #8090A0, and a 2px #F06000 rule beneath. Each question sits under the band of its block and never splits across pages: a 40px left-gutter circle with its order, filled #F06000 with a #000000 numeral when must_ask, otherwise a 2px rgba(240,224,208,.22) outline with a #FFFFFF numeral; a chip row in mono uppercase 7pt (MUST-ASK on #F06000 with #000000 text; E MORE MONEY, F MORE TIME, Q BETTER QUALITY and the bank number (Q12) or CUSTOM as #242424 chips with #F0E0D0 text; EMAIL OK outlined); the question text in Inter 600 11pt #FFFFFF in quotation marks; DIG DEEPER with the probes as bullets; WE KNOW (only when known is not empty) with a 3px #F06000 left border on #1A1A1A; WHY ASK and WRITE DOWN as labelled lines; then at least 20mm of answer space ruled with rgba(240,224,208,.22) hairlines. Labels are mono uppercase 7pt #8090A0. After the last block a CLOSE band with WRAP THE CALL and ASK THEM TO SEND panels, then LISTEN FOR: a #1A1A1A panel of unscored ideas, each with its question numbers, under the line Don't pitch these; they are scored only after the answers support them. The HTML adds a sticky top bar with the title, an asked counter (0/N) and a Clear checks button, plus an Asked checkbox on each question that marks the circle with a 2px #F06000 outline; it may keep checks in local storage. The PDF shows an empty box instead. Body at least 9pt, labels and footer at least 7pt. Footer bottom left and Page n of N bottom right on every page. Editable DOCX, the printable working copy: white A4 page, 18mm margins, no page colour; a #000000 header band with a 3pt #F06000 bottom border holding the verified logo or the disclosed wordmark; named styles Title (Montserrat bold 22pt All Caps white on #000000), Heading 1 (Montserrat bold 12pt All Caps white on #1A1A1A) for each block with its time, Heading 2 (Montserrat bold 10.5pt All Caps #000000, 3pt #F06000 left border) and Normal (Inter 10.5pt #1A1A1A); each question starts with a checkbox glyph, its order and bank number in Montserrat bold #C04A00 and MUST-ASK when it applies, then the question, the DIG DEEPER bullets and the WE KNOW, WHY ASK and WRITE DOWN lines as bold #242424 labels; each answer space a one-cell table at least 20mm high with a 0.5pt #8090A0 border and a 3pt #F06000 left border; leave_with in a #F06000-shaded cell with bold #000000 text; footer text and Page X of Y fields on every page. The DOCX keeps the same text, numbers and order as the PDF as editable Word text: no page images or text boxes, no #F06000 or #8090A0 text on white. Never embed the variable font files in the DOCX; embed static Montserrat 800 and Inter 400/700 instances only if the host can cut them, otherwise tell the user to install Montserrat and Inter. Keep test/debug disclosures outside the customer-facing guide. Expected value: "discovery_guide".

instruction.description: Text. Unreviewed draft. Keep every bank question's number, text and lens exactly as returned (they come from a bank you do not have); compare every quote with the current source; correct unsupported content before rendering. Then enforce the hard limits: 12-18 questions with 8-12 must-ask; every must_ask false question in a Pick from these block just before Wrap up; every bank number written as Q plus digits and used once; blocks back to back from 0:03, each at least three minutes, with Wrap up as the final four minutes ending at duration_minutes; renumber order 1 to N after any move. Keep all four trial prerequisites as returned. If objective names another tool, call that tool with the original source instead of rendering. Resolve pinned branding from the input parameter description (also in document_type schema metadata); verify asset hashes and inspect every page. If unavailable, follow the fallback rule and disclose the limitation. Generate real HTML/PDF and an editable DOCX. Claim only actual downloads. Disclose corrections separately.

required.description: True or false. Expected value: true.
